job.title: Mid-Level Interior Designer
job.description:
THE OPPORTUNITY

Brisbane is one of the busiest design markets in the country right now. With the 2032 Olympics on the horizon and continued investment in hospitality and residential projects, there’s no shortage of work. The real question for designers is where to do it.

We’re working with a national design practice to find a mid-level Interior Designer for their Brisbane studio. It’s a genuine all-rounder role, with involvement across the full project life cycle on hotel, hospitality and luxury residential work.

WHAT YOU’LL BE WORKING ON

  • Hotel and hospitality projects, from concept through to documentation and delivery
  • Luxury residential interiors where detail and finish quality really matter
  • Design development, FF&E selection and material specifications
  • Revit documentation and coordination with architects, consultants and contractors
  • Working closely with senior designers and having regular contact with clients

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

  • At least 4 years’ interior design experience in the Australian market
  • A portfolio that includes hotel, hospitality and luxury residential projects
  • Strong Revit skills (this studio documents in Revit, so it’s essential)
  • An all-round skill set, comfortable moving between design thinking and technical documentation
  • Good communication skills and the confidence to work directly with clients and consultants
  • A relevant degree in Interior Design or Interior Architecture

WHAT’S ON OFFER

  • $90,000 to $110,000 + super, depending on experience
  • The stability and project pipeline of a national practice
  • A clear career pathway, with genuine scope to step up as your experience grows
  • Well-established internal processes, so projects run smoothly and you can focus on the design
  • Hospitality and residential projects with real design ambition

WHY CONSIDER THIS ROLE?

When a market is this busy, plenty of studios are stretched. Projects get rushed, processes slip and development takes a back seat. This practice is different.

Their internal processes are excellent, which means clear briefs, organised documentation and fewer late-night fire drills before a deadline. Designers here spend their time designing.

There’s also somewhere to go. The practice actively develops its people, and for a mid-level designer looking for a path towards senior roles, that matters as much as the projects themselves.

HOW TO APPLY

job.title: Project Architect / Senior Project Architect (Multi-Residential)
job.description:
A Project Architect has mastered the delivery of projects of the size and scale typical of a local design firm. To run a project with autonomy whilst also ensuring a high standard of client service, project service quality, and office standards. Will refer to the Associate Architect and Director for guidance on design, variations, and project outcomes.

A Project Architect will, in various project phases, manage a team to assist in the delivery of the project and will be responsible for the coordination and checking of documents produced by team members. A Project Architect will be effective in managing time for the project and achieving all deadlines.

Role Responsibilities:

  • Take responsibility for the development of the design and the project with input from the Director or Associate in charge of key project stages.
  • Prepare and develop (with the team where required) documentation relating to the design.
  • Work autonomously and collaboratively to deliver across all stages of architectural projects.
  • Ensure design responses are appropriate, solution-focused, and address the client brief.
  • Take responsibility for the coordination and checking of documents.
  • Create specifications and revise drawings and specs as required.
  • Supervise and coordinate the wider team, including multi-disciplinary design coordination.
  • Drive the delivery of documentation and architectural packages within the team.
  • Manage and inspire through design and technical leadership.
  • Report to the Director or Associate on organisational activities and feedback.
  • Clear understanding and application of local design firm standards and procedures.
  • Maintain ongoing professional competencies.

Qualifications and Knowledge:

  • A tertiary degree from a recognised school of Architecture.
  • Registration as an Architect in Queensland (Ideally).
  • Relevant multi-residential specific experience.
  • A knowledge base commensurate with industry best practice.
  • High level of skill across Microsoft suite and Creative Cloud.
  • In-depth knowledge of BCA, NCC, and Australian Standards.
  • Revit proficiency is a must.
  • Outstanding communication skills and record-keeping.

Please contact Lee Stevens (Director of Vivid Recruitment) on 0406 470 020 to discuss further or send your CV and Design Folio to Lee@vividrecruitment.com.au.
